title: Keto-friendly Garlicky Stir-fry
description: A chewy and adventurous Kenyan dish featuring garlic, coconut cream, and other keto-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: green beans
ingredients.amount: 200g (about 3/4 cup), trimmed and cut into small pieces

instructions: In a large skillet or wok, heat coconut milk over medium-high heat. Add minced garlic and green beans, stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes until the beans are just tender.
Add zucchini and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until slightly softened.
Stir in coconut cream and lime juice, continuing to stir until well combined and heated through. Adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
Gently fold in spinach leaves and continue to toss until they are wilted but still retain their texture.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
